chunks: "O Moses, I am verily your Lord, so take off your shoes, for you are in the holy plain of Towa."
ai.seo_question: What does Allah command Moses to do when he is in the holy valley of Towa?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Taa-Haa, Allah commands Prophet Moses (AS) to remove his sandals upon entering the holy valley of Tuwaa, signifying a state of spiritual purity and reverence before the Divine Presence. Shia scholars often highlight this moment as a precursor to the bestowal of prophethood, emphasizing the sanctity of the location and the humility required to receive revelation. The act of removing footwear serves as a physical manifestation of shedding worldly attachments to stand in direct communion with God.
